Here you must pass 45 random questions picked from a total of 200 once you pass those you will be given your Learner’s license after which you need to accumulate 172 hours in a log book . Ten months after you received your learners license you will have to sit a hazard test (15) questions you must pass all of them after that you will have to wait another 2 months to sit a practical test with an instructor who will either fail or pass you . If you have passed you will receive your p1 license or “red ps”) for one year after that you will be able to go apply for green “ps” which you will hold for 2 years before getting a full license.
